scheme_name: Award of Scholarship to Differently Abled Person Students
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native or resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years.
Student must be enrolled in studies from Class 1 up to postgraduate or professional courses.
benefits_summary: Scholarship amounts range from ₹1,000 to ₹6,800 per year, varying with the student’s educational level.
documents_required: Prescribed application form (hard copy or printed)
Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
